name: Bernard Světlé výčepní 10
description: Bottom-fermented, unpasteurised pale draught beer brewed with Žatec hops. Light-bodied and pale golden with a mild bitterness.

name: Bernard 11 světlý ležák
description: Bottom-fermented, unpasteurised Czech pale lager. Balanced bitterness with a malty body and a hoppy aroma.

name: Bernard Sváteční ležák 12
description: Bottom-fermented pale lager with fine yeast added at bottling, so it re-ferments in the bottle and may be slightly hazy. Lively carbonation with a yeasty aroma and flavour.

name: Bernard IPA
description: Top-fermented, full-bodied pale India Pale Ale brewed at 12 °P. Fruity hop aroma contrasted by a stronger bitterness.

name: Holba Keprník 12
description: Bottom-fermented golden-amber pale lager hopped with a blend of four Czech varieties: Premiant, Sládek, Žatec semi-early red and Saaz Brilliant. Clean, balanced bitterness.

name: Holba Horská 10
description: Light-bodied pale draught beer brewed with water from the brewery's own well, Moravian barley malt and Czech hops. Crisp and refreshing character.

name: Radegast Ryze hořká 12
description: Bottom-fermented pale lager hopped three times with Czech hop varieties. Full-bodied with a pronounced bitter finish (36 IBU) and a hoppy aroma.

name: Radegast Rezist
description: Limited-edition 11 °P pale lager brewed with drought-resistant Czech hop varieties (Juno, Saaz Shine, Agnus). Bitter (39 IBU) with an earthy, grassy hop aroma.

name: Mosaic Ale 12
description: Top-fermented single-hop American Pale Ale built around the Mosaic hop. Light malt body with citrus, fruity and floral hop notes.

name: Robin 12
description: Pale, light-bodied American Pale Ale brewed with oat flakes and hopped with Citra and Simcoe. Citrus and resinous hop character with a moderate bitterness.

name: Dobrušská 11
description: Unfiltered, unpasteurised bottom-fermented pale lager with a full malty body. Medium carbonation and a balanced bitterness (33 EBU).

name: Rampušák 12
description: Unfiltered, unpasteurised pale lager hopped with Žatec varieties Sládek, Saaz Late and Žatec semi-early red. Full malty body with a pronounced bitterness (35 EBU).

name: Ogar Jedenáctka
description: Bottom-fermented pale lager brewed from Pilsner and Vienna malts with Czech hops (Žatec semi-early red, Premiant). Malty, bready character with a light bitterness (28 IBU).

name: Ogar IPA 14
description: Top-fermented India Pale Ale brewed with four hop varieties and cold-hopped. Citrus aroma and flavour with a distinct bitterness (45 IBU).

name: Ogar Kazbek 12
description: Very pale 12 °P lager hopped and cold-hopped exclusively with the Czech Kazbek variety. Spicy bitterness with a floral and citrus aroma.

name: Alojz 11
description: Unfiltered, unpasteurised bottom-fermented Pilsner-type lager brewed only with Pilsner malt. Very pale with a malty body and moderate bitterness (33 IBU).

name: Vincent 12
description: Unfiltered, unpasteurised bottom-fermented Pilsner-type pale lager with a fuller body. Firmly bitter finish (40 IBU).

name: Fešák lázeňský 13
description: Bottom-fermented, cold-hopped India Pale Lager, unfiltered and unpasteurised. Clean lager base with a hoppy aroma and a long bitter finish (35 IBU).

name: Kyjovská Jedenáctka
description: Unfiltered, unpasteurised bottom-fermented pale lager brewed with barley and rye malt and matured for five weeks. Balanced body with a clean Czech hop bitterness.

name: Kyjovský prémiový ležák
description: Unfiltered, unpasteurised Pilsner-style pale lager produced by decoction mashing and matured for five weeks. Full body and lively carbonation (35 IBU).

name: Pilsner Urquell
description: Bottom-fermented pale lager of the original Pilsner type, hopped with Saaz hops (39 IBU). Firm bitterness balanced by the caramel-like sweetness of Pilsner malt.

name: Matuška 10°
description: Pale draught lager brewed by double decoction mashing. Full body and a higher bitterness for its strength.

name: Matuška 12°
description: Unfiltered, unpasteurised Pilsner-style pale lager with a full body, hoppy aroma and pronounced bitterness.

name: Matuška Raptor IPA
description: Amber top-fermented India Pale Ale brewed at 15 °P and hopped with four varieties, including Saaz Special and Amarillo. Unfiltered and unpasteurised.

name: Matuška Apollo Galaxy
description: Top-fermented summer ale based on British pale ale, brewed at 13 °P (45 IBU). Galaxy and Citra hops add a tropical fruit aroma, Apollo hops provide the bitterness.

name: Heineken Lager
description: Bottom-fermented Dutch pale lager brewed from malted barley, water and hops with the brewery's proprietary A-yeast. Mild malt sweetness and a light hop bitterness (about 23 IBU).

name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro
description: Pale golden Italian premium lager launched in 1963, brewed with barley malt and maize. Crisp and dry with a delicate bitterness and subtle citrus aroma.

name: Tyskie Gronie
description: Golden Polish pale lager brewed in Tychy. Balance of hoppy bitterness and malty fullness with a sweeter malt character than the brewery's Classic variant.

name: Stiegl Goldbräu
description: Austrian Märzen-style lager brewed at 12 °P with water from the Untersberg mountain. Bright golden with a clean, crisp finish and a finely balanced malt character.

name: Hotline 15
description: Top-fermented West Coast IPA with a dry, well-attenuated malt body and high bitterness. Citrus and resin hop character from Columbus, Mosaic, Citra, Cascade and Simcoe.
